name: astra
description: Reference for the ASTRA specification (astra.yaml): top-level structure, sub-analyses, inputs/outputs, decisions and options, prior insights and findings, evidence and quote verification, and composition mechanics. Standalone — use ASTRA without the rest of the stack. Invoke when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA schema or sub-analysis composition.
